result.summary: Found 1 issue: the second section heading shows the raw localization key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of translated text. The rest of the page (header, search, category chips, promo banner, 'Fastest near you' carousel, restaurant card, bottom navigation) renders correctly. The clipped last carousel item and the partially visible pizza card at the bottom are expected scroll behavior.

issues.description: The section heading above the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card shows the raw i18n key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of a human-readable title (e.g., 'Popular near you'). The translation string is missing or failed to resolve.
issues.suggestion: Add the missing 'home_feed.popular_title' entry to the localization resources for the active locale. Configure the i18n library to fall back to the default language instead of showing raw keys, and add a check that flags unresolved keys before release.
